evidence: AGENTS.md and .ai/README.md expose a large transitive governance tree that is repeatedly analyzed during multi-wave AI work.
The repository already preserves native per-run instruction discovery and separates Foundation, project-semantic, and runtime validation.
No project decision currently selects a persistent cache location or the optional rule-context-cache capability.
assessments.rationale: Session-local reuse with fail-closed fingerprint and dependency checks can reduce repeated rule analysis without changing authority. The core policy is integrated, while the optional executable capability and a persistent cache location remain unselected because the current task does not authorize that durable project choice.
assessments.recommendation: Use the 1.8.0 session-local analysis contract between later change waves when every cache invariant is proven; otherwise perform a full reread. Evaluate the optional reference capability separately before selecting any persistent cache destination.
